topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe it. Everything I thought I knew, just... gone. My friend, someone I trusted, spinning tales about their job. I feel like I don't even know them anymore. What else have they been hiding? The lies, they weren’t just about their work. It's like they built a whole other life, and I was just watching a performance, never suspecting a thing. Now, I’m left here, piecing together the fragments of a friendship that might not have been real at all. How do you move forward from this? How do you trust again when the ground you stood on was a lie?
